reason: The cited evidence shows that adding HEA reinforcement to Cu reduces wear severity (E1) and that oxide layers and plastic deformation govern wear in a different material (E2), but neither passage provides direct support for Cu segregation to grain boundaries, the lubricious nature of Cu-rich films, or their effect on shear band suppression in FeNiCrCoCu coatings.
premises: Cu segregation to grain boundaries in FeNiCrCoCu HEA can be induced by annealing at ~700 °C
Cu-rich intergranular films are softer and lubricious at high temperature
